summary.content:
Today's selection covers 56 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI releases ChatGPT 5.6 Cyber, but it's only for approved users
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: When Credentials Are No Longer Enough: Device Trust in the AI Era
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 47 articles published in the last 24 hours
